description: Move a scheduled SMS to a new time, 1 minute to 30 days ahead, and optionally its expires_at. Anything not still scheduled is MESSAGE_NOT_SCHEDULED.

expires_at.description: New latest send time: 1 minute to 24 hours after the new scheduled_at, or null for the default (scheduled_at plus 24 hours). Left out, the current one is kept while it still fits the new scheduled_at, else the default applies.

name: reschedule_message
title: Reschedule SMS
